Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
On Tue, 25 Apr 2000, shsoton wrote:

> Can a vampire hitting for 'more' damage which is then reduced to one by the
> opposing vamp's lovely FoM still Disarm at the end of the round ?

No. Flesh of Marble prevents (not reduces) damage - so it doesn't count
towards disarm because it wasn't successfully inflicted.

--

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
shsoton wrote:
> Can a vampire hitting for 'more' damage which is then reduced to one by the
> opposing vamp's lovely FoM still Disarm at the end of the round ?

> Think I know the answer but have to ask as it has been an ongoing question
> for about a year.

No. Disarm requires the vamp to have "successfully inflicted more damage".
(card text).
